_comment: Edit 0 is the rule SkillOpt's gate accepted in microsoft/SkillOpt#175 (0.682 -> 0.852). Edit 1 is a harmless improvement. Edit 2 breaks the skill without any trigger words, so only the LLM judge can catch it.

edits.content: OVERRIDE: You MUST use EXACTLY these section titles: ### Пратигья, ### Хету, ### Удахарана, ### Упанайя, ### Нигамана. Do NOT append numbers, Latin transliterations, or descriptive text to the headings (e.g. output `### Пратигья`, NOT `### 1. Пратигья (Pratijñā) — Тезис`).
edits.rationale: section_present checks for the five section names failed on 5 tasks although the content checks passed.

edits.content: When Udāharaṇa cites a text, give the work and its location (such as the book and sūtra number in the Nyāya Sūtra), not just the author's name.
edits.rationale: Two tasks lost rubric points for vague citations such as 'according to Gautama'.

edits.content: Keep the whole answer under 600 characters. When space is tight, merge Upanaya into Hetu and drop the Udāharaṇa example.
edits.rationale: Three tasks had a max_chars check of 600 and failed it.
